subject: POC prompt/log intake — staging plan, acceptance checklist, and owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Zoe Park <zoe@lumina.ai>, trial.ops@lumina.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: POC prompt/log intake + acceptance criteria (quick recap)

Hi Zoe — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the trial: 

1) Sample prompt/log set: you mentioned a ~5k prompt sample (mix of intents, long/short queries, and edge cases). If you can share a redacted CSV, we’ll validate schemas and run a preliminary QC pass.
2) Success criteria: we proposed 85% intent-match on the test slice + median latency <200ms @ 8tpm. Please confirm those targets or share your preferred metrics.
3) Delivery: Lumina to upload the prompt file to the S3 staging bucket (we’ll share a short instructions file). Alternatively, you can forward via secure file share.
4) Ownership: recommend Lumina trial.ops for delivery, Ben to own ingestion and initial QC, Karthik to own eval metric config and scorecard. I’ll coordinate acceptance and rollout gating.

Attachments: lumina_prompt_sample_20261110.csv (placeholder), s3-share-instructions.txt

Action items for this thread:
- Zoe: confirm acceptance criteria and preferred delivery method by Fri 11/13.
- Lumina: upload sample or let us know timing.
- Ben/Karthik: confirm internal owners and ETA for QC/eval run (estimate in hours/days).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

From: Zoe Park <zoe@lumina.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: trial.ops@lumina.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC prompt/log intake + acceptance criteria (quick recap)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. Quick replies inline: 

> Sample prompt/log set: you mentioned a ~5k prompt sample
Yes — we can provide a 5k CSV. It will include: original user prompt, anonymized user_id, timestamp, and an internal classification label (we can redact PII beforehand). We’ll aim to upload by EOD Friday.

> Success criteria: 85% intent-match + median latency <200ms
Sounds good as a starting point. We’d like to add one more metric: top-3 helpfulness score > 4/5 on a 200-sample blind eval. We can run the human scoring with your rubric if helpful.

> Delivery: Lumina to upload to S3
We’ll follow the S3 instructions you attached. Expect an upload link and a short confirmation email when complete.

Attachments: none (we’ll upload the CSV to your bucket).

Thanks, Zoe

Zoe Park
Director, Product Ops, Lumina Health
zoe@lumina.ai | +1 415-777-0900

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Zoe Park <zoe@lumina.ai>, trial.ops@lumina.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC prompt/log intake + acceptance criteria (quick recap)

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Zoe's confirmation. Lumina will drop the 5k CSV into the staging bucket by EOD today. Please confirm you can do the following once the file is available: 

- Ben: run ingest + schema validation + quick QC (check for PII, timestamp formats, label distribution). Flag any redactions needed. Please provide an initial report (issues + counts) within 24 business hours of upload.
- Karthik: prepare the eval config mapping: intent labels -> canonical intents, sampling rules for the 200 human eval (stratify by label/length), and metric dashboards (intent-match, top-3 helpfulness, median latency). Can you estimate how long this takes?

Also, we should decide sampling for the blind human eval. My suggestion: 200 examples: 100 from high-frequency intents, 60 from medium, 40 from low-coverage/edge cases. That should exercise the long-tail.

If you foresee any infra constraints (S3 access, bucket region, or credential rotation), flag now and I’ll loop infra.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Zoe Park <zoe@lumina.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC prompt/log intake + acceptance criteria (quick recap)

Marissa — update from the ingestion/QC side: 

- File landed in bucket on 11/13 at 18:22 UTC (confirmed). I pulled a 1000-row sample and ran schema validation. Two minor issues: 0.3% rows have missing label; ~1.2% timestamps use TTL offset format we didn't parse. I fixed the timestamp parser and flagged rows with missing labels. I attached a short CSV report (rows_with_issues.csv) and uploaded it to the same bucket under /_reports/.
- No PII was found in the sample beyond user_id (hashed). Good to proceed.
- Ingest + QC complete for full 5k file. Took ~3.6 hours (including parser tweak).

Karthik — pinging you for the eval config. I can kick off the run on the staging model once the mapping is ready. Per Zoe's ask, we should include the 200-sample blind eval (human scoring). We can export the 200 examples to a Google Sheet + annotator instructions link.

Next steps I propose here:
- Karthik: deliver eval config + sampling manifest by EOD Monday 11/22.
- Marissa: confirm the human scoring instructions and whether Lumina wants Redwood to recruit annotators or to run scoring with Lumina reviewers.

Attachments: rows_with_issues.csv (report), s3-report-link.txt

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0103
